BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a state centennial song; and addinga new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature hereby designates the song, music, and lyrics to"Washington My Homeland," composed by Cary J. Sand, as the officialstate centennial song.
